title: 第5章 入门
content_zh:
傍晚，测试结束，主考官和齐峰带领选拔合格的新弟子一起上山。

来到半山腰上，主考官带着众人走进一座雄伟大殿，恭恭敬敬的拜道：“弟子方忠，拜见掌门和各位师伯师叔，今年的新弟子选拔圆满完成。”

“好，我们看看。”大殿中央，一名神色和蔼的白发老者道，他声音平和自然，但是却极有力量。

除了白发老者之外，大殿里还站着数名修士，大多是老者，即使年轻一些的，也到了中年。不过即使老者，脸上也极少皱纹，肌肤更是隐隐透出晶莹的光泽，仿佛用特殊材料制成。

看见众新弟子进来，这些修士目光纷纷扫过来。

众新弟子立刻有种全身都被看透的感觉，不由得心跳加快，战战兢兢地站好，不敢抬头直视。

那白发老者目光逐一扫过，最后落在卓不凡和李元瑶身上，眼睛一亮：“唔，这两个新弟子看上去很不错啊，你们觉得呢？”

“的确不错，已经很多年没有遇到到这样根骨奇佳的弟子了。”

“这少年内蕴灵秀，神采斐然，这少女惊才绝艳，灵动过人，可以称得上是天才。”

众修士纷纷点头，眼中露着热切，对卓不凡和李元瑶极为看好。

方忠忙道：“掌门，这少年叫做卓不凡，少女叫李元瑶，资质测试都是优秀，而且都突破了后天一重炼气境，是我正玄门近十年来选拔中，资质最好的弟子。”

白发老者微微动容，露出几分喜色：“怪不得，原来是资质优秀，方忠，你做得很好！”

方忠喜滋滋道：“这是弟子应该做的。此外，还有一名新弟子，测试情况出乎意料，弟子无法判断他的情况，所以特地带上山，请掌门和各位师伯师叔定夺。”

他把夏尘导致测试石自燃的异状说了一遍。

“哦？还有这等事情？倒是要好好看看此子，究竟有什么与众不同！”白发老者和众修士吃了一惊，目光又转移到夏尘身上。

刚才在打量众新弟子的时候，夏尘并不出奇，因此他们也没在意，想不到此子竟然如此奇异，难道是传说中隐伏极深的绝世天才？

众新弟子眼神微妙，均想这家伙可够牛的，把卓不凡和李元瑶都比下去了。

卓不凡和李元瑶目光灼灼，带着深深地不服之意，身为天才，自然不希望遇见更强大的天才。

被这么多人同时盯着，夏尘不禁遍体生寒，心砰砰跳着，担心体内异物被发现，只得表面强自镇定。

半响，众修士面面相觑，露出失望之色。

“此子看上去似乎颇为坚毅，好象很适合修行，但是根骨寻常，资质平庸，就连普通弟子都比不上啊。”

“这哪是什么绝世天才，分明和凡人无异，能修炼出真气感应都是勉强。”

“真让人失望啊，此子表现颇为奇异，想不到这么平庸，唉！”

“他就算是修行，最多到后天三重也就是尽头了，资质太差，潜力也十分有限。”

众修士纷纷摇头，收回了目光，瞬间对夏尘索然无趣。他们都是老辈修士，自可轻易看透后天弟子。

白发老者也遗憾地叹了口气，本以为可能捞着一个绝世天才，谁想却是个天大玩笑。

不少新弟子眼神立刻变成了轻视，均想这家伙看似一鸣惊人，原来比我们还远远不如，倒是高看他了。

卓不凡和李元瑶松了口气，淡淡地瞥了夏尘一眼，露出一丝不屑。

只有一名清瘦老者，看着夏尘目光流露出若有所思之意，但却没有说话。

夏尘神色淡然，从当杂役的时候，这些打击他便不知道承受了多少，早已经心坚如铁，任凭别人如何嘲讽，都只当是犬吠驴叫。

众修士也不再理会夏尘，商议一阵后，卓不凡和李元瑶因为资质优秀，在白发老者亲自定夺下，被一名叫做岳子峰的修士和一名叫徐芳的女修士分别选为亲传弟子。

至于夏尘等人无人问津，只能按照老规矩，从最普通弟子做起。

随后，方忠带着众新弟子离开大殿，又到另一座执事殿里履行登记手续，分发弟子手册、门派服饰及生活用具，然后带着众人在门派内部游走，讲解门规和注意事项。

通过方忠讲解，夏尘这才明白，亲传弟子和普通弟子差别极大。亲传弟子不但可以得到老辈修士亲自教导，而且可以享受种种资源和特权，比如丹药、功法、宝物等等，地位和普通弟子根本不在一个层次上。

至于普通弟子就很苦逼了，没有师承，也没有资源，地位也最低下，一切全靠自己苦修，只有修炼到后天五重以上或者是有特殊机缘，才有可能被老辈修士看中，成为亲传弟子。当然，这种机会是微乎其微的，绝大多数普通弟子都只是最大众的垫脚石。

最后，方忠给新弟子指派庭院住处后，随即离去。

众新弟子都是精神一振。从上山开始，面对的不是老弟子就是师门长辈，连大气都不敢喘一下，此刻，终于可以轻松一些了。

“卓师兄，李师姐，师弟我叫吴刚，刚进入门派，还要请两位多多照顾啊，呵呵。”一名长满疙瘩的弟子满脸堆笑，向着卓不凡和李元瑶拱手道。

他明显比卓不凡和李元瑶大上数岁，但是口中师兄师姐叫得极其自然，笑容更是堆满了谄媚。

“我叫杨二，能和卓师兄还有李师姐这样的天才一起入门，是师弟的荣幸，以后师兄师姐有什么事情，尽管吩咐下来就好了。”另一名魁梧的新弟子也拍着胸脯奉迎道。

其他不少新弟子也纷纷上前，犹如众星捧月一般围着卓不凡和李元瑶，极力讨好着。

卓不凡和李元瑶既是天才，又成为亲选弟子，日后迟早会出类拔萃，成为杰出弟子，自然要趁此机会巴结一下。

不过也有几名新弟子没有上前，夏尘自是其中之一。

李元瑶脸色淡淡，就象没听到众人的曲意逢迎，她自视极高，根本不屑和普通弟子说话。

卓不凡也只是微微点头，算是应和。

“卓师兄，李师姐，在下的表兄宋青山是正玄派的老弟子，混得还可以，在门派内部办什么事都很方便，如果师兄师姐有什么要师弟帮忙的，说一声就行。”吴刚笑道。

他察言观色，知道两人性情高傲，对自己等人没什么兴趣，于是特地提起了在门派内部的关系。

卓不凡神色一动，他虽然是亲选弟子，但毕竟刚入门，脚跟没站稳，倒是不好忽视吴刚这等关系，于是微微拱手道：“吴师弟客气了，我们既然是同门，自然要团结一致，相互帮忙。”

李元瑶虽然没说话，但是神色也缓和了许多，向着吴刚微微点头示意。

吴刚顿时双眼放光，满脸疙瘩似乎都跟着熠熠生辉，笑道：“团结一致，卓师兄说得太好了，兄弟们，我有个提议，我们这批新弟子不如组成一个小团体，以卓师兄和李师姐为首领，你们说好不好？”

“好！”其他新弟子热烈响应。眼前这三人有两个是亲选弟子，一个在门派内部有关系，自然巴不得和他们混在一起。

卓不凡和李元瑶淡淡一笑，虽然不置可否，但是被众人捧着，眼神也带了几分得意。

“喂，你们几个，怎么不过来拜见卓师兄和李师姐？”吴刚目光一瞥，看见夏尘等几名新弟子，立刻盛气凌人地喝道。

夏尘等几名新弟子本来正要离去，闻言顿时停住脚步，皱起眉头。

“你们听不懂我说的话？”吴刚脸色不善，大步走近，对着几人指指戳戳，“刚才我说都要听卓师兄和李师姐的命令？还不赶快过来。”

“尤其是你，夏尘。”他趾高气扬地看着夏尘，“一个靠着运气才入门的杂役，本来以你平庸的资质，根本没资格和我们平起平坐，现在给你机会，那是你的荣幸，知道吗？”

“我不想加入你们，也不想听谁的命令。”夏尘道。他十分看不惯吴刚耍两面派的可憎模样，但是现在刚进门派，还是尽量要低调一些。

“不错，我们也不想加入你们。”那几名新弟子也纷纷道。

“敢拒绝？”吴刚脸色阴沉下来，“好大的胆子，你们这是对卓师兄和李师姐的不敬。”

“吴刚，我们要的是精英，不是垃圾。”卓不凡淡淡道，“一个潜力最多只有后天三重的杂役，要来干什么，当废物养吗？”

“一介小丑，就算跪在地下恳求，也不要他。”李元瑶轻蔑地瞥了夏尘一眼，瞬间收回目光。

夏尘在测试时盖过卓不凡和李元瑶的风头，两人心里一直颇不舒服，此时便趁机发作。

“是，卓师兄，李师姐，我没打算收这杂役，不过是耍他玩而已。”吴刚连忙点头哈腰。

“我本来也没想加入你们，就算跪地上求我，我也不会加入。”夏尘心头有气，冷冷丢下一句话，就要转身离去，这些人就象是苍蝇一般让他心里厌恶。

“站住，我让你走了吗？”吴刚喝道。

“瘪三，刚才说什么屁话？”吴刚冷笑，“我命令你，马上给卓师兄和李师姐道歉，我们什么时候让你走，你才能走，而且以后见到我们，你得绕着走，听明白没有？”

“滚！”夏尘脸色冰寒，怒火再也无法遏制。

“**想死，给脸不要脸，今天我把你打到吃屎！”吴刚大怒，挥掌狠狠向着夏尘脸上扇来。

咚！他的手掌刚挥到一半，一记无坚不摧地铁拳猛然击出，狠狠击在他小腹上。

吴刚眼珠瞬间突出，面孔变得青紫，完全扭曲变形。他捂着腹部，噗通一声跪倒在地上，还没等挣扎，夏尘一脚狠狠踩在他后颈上：“刚才你说什么？”

content_en:
In the evening, the test ended, and the examiner and Qi Feng led the qualified new disciples up the mountain together.

Arriving halfway up the mountain, the examiner led everyone into a majestic hall and bowed respectfully: "Disciple Fang Zhong, I would like to pay my respects to the master and all the masters and uncles. This year's selection of new disciples has been successfully completed."

"Okay, let's take a look." In the center of the hall, a white-haired old man with a kind expression said. His voice was calm and natural, but extremely powerful.

In addition to the white-haired old man, there were several monks standing in the hall, most of them were old men, even the younger ones were in middle age.However, even the old man has very few wrinkles on his face, and his skin has a faint crystal luster, as if it is made of special materials.

Seeing the new disciples coming in, these monks glanced over.

The new disciples immediately felt as if their whole bodies were being seen through, and their heartbeats could not help but quicken. They stood tremblingly, not daring to raise their heads and look directly.

The white-haired old man glanced at each one one by one, and finally landed on Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao, his eyes lit up: "Well, these two new disciples look very good, what do you think?"

"It's indeed good. It's been many years since I've met such a disciple with such excellent bones."

"This young man has a lot of intelligence and spirit, and this young girl is amazingly talented and smart. She can be called a genius."

All the monks nodded one after another, their eyes showing enthusiasm, and they were extremely optimistic about Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao.

Fang Zhong said hurriedly: "Master, this boy is called Zhuo Bufan, and the girl is called Li Yuanyao. They are both excellent in aptitude tests, and both have broken through the first level of acquired Qi refining realm. They are the most qualified disciples selected by our Zhengxuan Sect in the past ten years."

The white-haired old man moved slightly and showed a bit of joy: "No wonder, it turns out you have excellent qualifications, Fang Zhong, you did a good job!"

Fang Zhong said happily: "This is what a disciple should do. In addition, there is a new disciple, and the test results are unexpected. The disciple cannot judge his situation, so I specially brought him up the mountain and asked the master and all the masters and uncles to make a decision."

He told Xia Chen about the abnormal situation that caused the test stone to spontaneously ignite.

"Oh? Is there such a thing? We should take a closer look at this boy to see what's so different about him!" The white-haired old man and the monks were startled, and their eyes shifted to Xia Chen.

When they were looking at the new disciples just now, Xia Chen was not surprised, so they didn't pay attention. They didn't expect that this boy was so strange. Could he be the legendary hidden genius?

All the new disciples had subtle looks in their eyes, thinking that this guy was so good that he could outshine Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao.

Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao's eyes were blazing with deep dissatisfaction. As geniuses, they naturally did not want to meet a more powerful genius.

Being stared at by so many people at the same time, Xia Chen couldn't help but feel chills all over his body. His heart was pounding. He was worried that foreign objects in his body would be discovered, so he had to force himself to remain calm.

After a while, all the monks looked at each other with disappointment.

"This boy seems to be quite determined, and seems to be very suitable for cultivation, but his bones are ordinary and his qualifications are mediocre. Even ordinary disciples cannot compare with him."

"This is not a peerless genius. He is clearly no different from ordinary people. He is barely capable of cultivating Qi sensing."

"It's really disappointing. This boy's performance is quite strange. I didn't expect him to be so mediocre. Alas!"

"Even if he practices cultivation, he will reach the end of the third level of acquired life at most. His qualifications are too poor and his potential is very limited."

All the monks shook their heads and withdrew their gazes, instantly losing interest in Xia Chen.They are all senior monks, so they can easily see through the acquired disciples.

The white-haired old man also sighed regretfully. He thought he might have found a peerless genius, but who thought it was a big joke.

The eyes of many new disciples immediately turned into contempt. They all thought that this guy seemed to be a blockbuster, but it turned out that he was far inferior to us, but they looked up to him.

Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao breathed a sigh of relief and glanced at Xia Chen with a hint of disdain.

There was only a thin old man who looked at Xia Chen thoughtfully, but said nothing.

Xia Chen looked indifferent. Ever since he was a handyman, he had endured many of these blows. His heart had already been as hard as iron. No matter how others ridiculed him, they would just treat it as a barking dog or a donkey's braying.

The monks ignored Xia Chen. After a while of discussion, Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao were selected as direct disciples by a monk named Yue Zifeng and a female monk named Xu Fang respectively because of their excellent qualifications and the white-haired old man personally decided.

As for Xia Chen and others, no one cares about them, so they can only follow the old rules and start from the most ordinary disciples.

Afterwards, Fang Zhong led the new disciples out of the main hall and went to another deacon hall to complete the registration procedures, distribute disciple manuals, sect clothing and daily utensils, and then led everyone around the sect to explain the sect rules and precautions.

Through Fang Zhong's explanation, Xia Chen finally understood that there was a huge difference between direct disciples and ordinary disciples.Personal disciples can not only be personally taught by older monks, but can also enjoy various resources and privileges, such as elixirs, exercises, treasures, etc. Their status is not at the same level as ordinary disciples.

As for ordinary disciples, it is very hard. They have no masters, no resources, and the lowest status. They have to rely on their own hard work. Only when they have cultivated to the fifth level or above or have special opportunities, can they be favored by the older monks and become direct disciples.Of course, this chance is very slim, and the vast majority of ordinary disciples are just stepping stones for the most common people.

Finally, Fang Zhong assigned the new disciple a residence in the courtyard and left immediately.

All the new disciples were refreshed.From the moment I went up the mountain, I was faced with either old disciples or elders from my master's sect, and I didn't even dare to take a breath. At this moment, I could finally relax a little.

"Senior Brother Zhuo, Senior Sister Li, Junior Brother, my name is Wu Gang. I just joined the sect, so I need to ask you two to take care of me, haha." A disciple with pimples on his face smiled and said to Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao.

He was obviously several years older than Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao, but he called him "senior brother and sister" very naturally, and his smile was full of flattery.

"My name is Yang Er. It's my honor to be able to join the ranks of geniuses like Senior Brother Zhuo and Senior Sister Li. If anything happens to Senior Brother and Senior Sister in the future, just give me your orders." Another burly new disciple also patted his chest to welcome him.

Many other new disciples also stepped forward, surrounding Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao like stars holding the moon, trying their best to please them.

Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao are both geniuses and personally chosen disciples. Sooner or later, they will excel and become outstanding disciples, so they naturally want to take this opportunity to curry favor with them.

However, there were also a few new disciples who did not step forward, and Xia Chen was one of them.

Li Yuanyao's face was pale, as if she didn't hear the people's flattery. She had a very high self-esteem and didn't even bother to talk to ordinary disciples.

Zhuo Bufan just nodded slightly in agreement.

"Senior Brother Zhuo, Senior Sister Li, and my cousin Song Qingshan are old disciples of the Zhengxuan Sect. They are doing well. It is very convenient to do anything within the sect. If senior brothers and sisters need help from me, just let me know." Wu Gang said with a smile.

He observed their words and knew that the two of them were arrogant and had little interest in him and others, so he specifically mentioned their relationship within the sect.

Zhuo Bufan's expression changed. Although he was a personally selected disciple, he had just started and had not yet established his feet firmly. It was difficult to ignore Wu Gang's relationship, so he slightly cupped his hands and said: "Junior brother Wu, you are welcome. Since we are from the same sect, we must unite and help each other."

Although Li Yuanyao didn't speak, his expression softened a lot, and he nodded slightly towards Wu Gang.

Wu Gang's eyes suddenly lit up, and the pimples on his face seemed to be shining brightly. He smiled and said: "We are united. Senior Brother Zhuo said it so well. Brothers, I have a suggestion. Our new batch of disciples should form a small group, with Senior Brother Zhuo and Senior Sister Li as the leaders. Can you agree?"

"Okay!" The other new disciples responded enthusiastically.Two of the three people in front of him were hand-chosen disciples, and one had connections within the sect, so naturally he wanted to hang out with them.

Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao smiled faintly. Although they were noncommittal, their eyes were a little proud as they were held up by everyone.

"Hey, you guys, why don't you come over to meet Senior Brother Zhuo and Senior Sister Li?" Wu Gang glanced at Xia Chen and several other new disciples, and immediately shouted arrogantly.

Xia Chen and the other new disciples were about to leave when they heard this and suddenly stopped and frowned.

"You don't understand what I said?" Wu Gang looked unkind, strode closer, pointed at several people, "I just said that we must obey the orders of Senior Brother Zhuo and Senior Sister Li? Why don't you come here quickly?"

"Especially you, Xia Chen." He looked at Xia Chen arrogantly, "A handyman who got into the job by luck. With your mediocre qualifications, you are not qualified to be on an equal footing with us. Now I give you a chance. It is your honor, you know?"

"I don't want to join you, and I don't want to listen to anyone's orders." Xia Chen said.He couldn't stand Wu Gang's abominable double-dealing, but now that he had just entered the sect, he still tried to keep a low profile.

"Yes, we don't want to join you either." The new disciples also said.

"Dare you refuse?" Wu Gang's face darkened, "You are so brave. You are disrespectful to Senior Brother Zhuo and Senior Sister Li."

"Wu Gang, what we want are elites, not trash." Zhuo Bufan said calmly, "A handyman with only the third level of acquired potential at most, what is he here to do? Is he going to be treated like trash?"

"I don't want a clown even if I kneel on the ground and beg him." Li Yuanyao glanced at Xia Chen contemptuously and looked away instantly.

Xia Chen overshadowed Zhuo Bufan and Li Yuanyao during the test. The two of them had been feeling uncomfortable, so they took the opportunity to have an attack.

"Yes, Senior Brother Zhuo, Senior Sister Li, I have no intention of recruiting this handyman, I am just playing with him." Wu Gang nodded quickly and bowed.

"I didn't want to join you. Even if you kneel down and beg me, I won't join." Xia Chen was angry. He said a cold word and turned to leave. These people disgusted him like flies.

"Stop, did I let you go?" Wu Gang shouted.

"Ya San, what nonsense did you just say?" Wu Gang sneered, "I order you to apologize to Senior Brother Zhuo and Senior Sister Li immediately. You can only leave when we let you go. And when you see us in the future, you have to go around. Do you understand?"

"Get out!" Xia Chen's face was cold, and his anger could no longer be contained.

"You want to die, you are so shameless, I will beat you until you eat shit today!" Wu Gang was furious and slapped Xia Chen hard on the face with his palm.

Boom!Just as he was halfway through swinging his palm, an indestructible iron fist suddenly came out and hit him hard on the lower abdomen.

Wu Gang's eyes instantly protruded, his face turned blue and completely distorted.He covered his abdomen and fell to his knees with a thud. Before he could struggle, Xia Chen stepped hard on the back of his neck: "What did you say just now?"
